headline: England 3-0 Czechia: Coufal own goal, Kane twice
whyCareReason: Tuesday's England game was against Czechia, not Greece. Spain's 2-1 win in Croatia sent Spain through.
teaser: Coufal 27 own goal, Kane 40 and 57. England 9 points. Czechia still 0.
story: England beat Czechia 3-0 at home on Tuesday 6 October. NEWS.am records Vladimir Coufal's own goal on 27 minutes and Harry Kane on 40 and 57. Xinhua prints the same 3-0. England have 9 points from four games, 14 goals for and 3 against. Czechia have 0 points, 2 goals for and 10 against. This was not a Wembley game against Greece.
stakes: England cannot catch Spain on points if Spain win out, and Spain are already through. Second place is England's race.
rivalryAngle: The same night Croatia lost 1-2 at home to Spain.
